# Split Optimized Plus (SOP) Client

> **The most powerful yet efficient Minecraft optimization pack.**

## 🚀 Built for Performance

This modpack was designed from the ground up for maximum performance. SOP Client allows anyone to enjoy the ultimate vanilla experience, even if you're playing on a toaster!

## 📦 What's Inside?

To achieve incredible framerates while actually *improving* the vanilla look and feel, SOP Client packs the absolute best open-source performance and visual mods available.

* **Extreme FPS & Optimization:** Powered by the holy trinity of **Sodium**, **Lithium**, and **FerriteCore**, alongside memory and rendering improvements from **ModernFix**, **EntityCulling**, **MoreCulling**, and **ImmediatelyFast**. Your game will run smoother and use significantly less RAM.
* **OptiFine Parity & Visuals:** Full support for custom entity models and textures via **EMF** and **ETF**. Also features **LambDynamicLights** (holding torches lights up the area), **Visuality** (better particles), **BetterGrassify**, and built-in **Iris** shader support (pre-loaded with *Complementary Reimagined* and *E-LITE* shaders!).
* **Multiplayer Enhancements:** Features **Bobby**, which saves server chunks on your client so you can see further than the server's render distance allows! Also includes **Simple Voice Chat** for proximity chat and **Krypton** for heavily optimized networking.
* **Audio Overhaul:** An entirely upgraded sound engine using **Audio Engine Tweaks** and **True Adaptive Music**, which dynamically shifts the soundtrack based on your gameplay and environment.
* **Quality of Life (QoL):** Packed with essentials to make playing less tedious, including **AppleSkin** (food/saturation details), **Mouse Tweaks** (better inventory sorting), **Zoomify** (smooth zooming), **Controlling** (easy keybind management), and **ModMenu** to configure it all.
* **Background Efficiency:** Mods like **Dynamic FPS** and **FPS Reducer 2** lower your resource usage when you tab out of the game, keeping your PC cool.

---

## 🧩 Why "Split"?

True optimization requires addressing both the client and the server independently. That’s why SOP is "Split" into two distinct packs! SOP Client pairs perfectly with the SOP Server pack, giving both ends exactly the mods they need to run flawlessly.

But don’t worry, **SOP Client will still heavily optimize your game even if the server you're joining isn't running SOP!**

---

## 💻 The SOP Client Experience

The client edition is tailored for players who want sky-high framerates without sacrificing the vanilla feel, whether you have a high-end rig or a low-end PC.

Beyond raw optimization, SOP Client includes carefully curated **Quality of Life (QoL) improvements** designed to make your gameplay infinitely more enjoyable. It has a special focus on Survival Multiplayer (SMP), but works perfectly for your singleplayer worlds, too!

---

## 🤝 Universal Compatibility

While the absolute best experience comes from pairing SOP Client with an SOP Server, we know you don't always own the servers you play on.

Because SOP is completely split and relies entirely on client-side mods, there are **no dependencies**. You can use SOP Client to connect to *any* vanilla server, anywhere, and still enjoy a buttery-smooth experience.
